title: Anduril platform rows
description: A full-bleed stone-grey band of big linked rows, each under a hairline: a 56px semibold name top left, a small all-caps line at the bottom of the text column, and a 4.25:1 media strip on the right 58%. Hovering a row (desktop) turns it black edge to edge, greys its text and draws in a ↗ link. Phones stack name, line, link and a 1.9:1 image. Rows fade in one after the other as they enter the view.
notes: uses the secondary surface (grey band, dark text); the hover inverts to secondary-foreground
